description: Renovate covers only the upstream sources that USL patches and builds itself: Pocket ID, Paperless-ngx, and Smokescreen. Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) keeps every other dependency, so the two bots never change the same pin. A pull request from Renovate is a signal that upstream moved. It usually fails CI until a person rebases the patch or updates the hashes.

customManagers.description: Pocket ID source of the patched image. The version and the commit of its tag change together.
The image tag that the Pocket ID workflow publishes, <upstream version>-usl<n>. Gitops Renovate watches this tag, so it must follow the upstream version.
Paperless-ngx source of the overlay. The version and the commit in the archive URL change together.
Smokescreen has no release tags after v0.1.0, so the build follows commits on its default branch.

packageRules.description: One pull request for each Pocket ID release: the Dockerfile and the workflow tag.
prBodyNotes: 1. Rebase `services/usl-pocket-id/*.patch` onto the new tag, and rename the file to the new version.
2. Check that the `Pocket ID image` workflow passes.
3. After the merge, pin the published digest in the gitops Pocket ID stack.

packageRules.description: Paperless upgrades need overlay work. The pull request opens at once and fails CI until someone does that work, so the open pull request is the reminder. Issues are off in this repository, so Renovate has no Dependency Dashboard, and no rule here can wait for a tick on it.
prBodyNotes: **Paperless overlay.** This pull request changes only the version and the source commit. Before you merge, follow `deploy/documents/paperless-ngx/README.md`:
1. Update the base image digest everywhere it appears (`git grep paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx@sha256`).
3. Rebase the overlay and its file hashes.

packageRules.description: Smokescreen changes often, and its updates are not urgent. One check each month is enough.
prBodyNotes: **Smokescreen.** Before you merge: update the archive SHA-256 and the short commit in the `usl-receipt-egress` image tag in `compose.yaml`, and check that `port-443-only.patch` still applies.
